content.text: The project, valued at €160,242, faces significant compliance risks due to missing mandatory technical specifications. Critical gaps include insulation parameters (thickness, WLS) jeopardizing GEG certification, undefined homogeneous areas per DIN 18300 causing unclear ground risk allocation, and absent water impact classes per DIN 18533. Additional low-priority omissions involve exposure and concrete strength classes. These deficiencies create substantial legal and structural uncertainties. Immediate action is required to complete all mandatory data points to ensure regulatory compliance, mitigate construction risks, and finalize accurate cost estimates before proceeding with execution.
